property.name: overflow
property.description-key: Overflow behavior: auto, scroll, hidden, visible

property.name: clearMessageAfterLoad
property.description-key: If true, the bound message field is set to null after display so no HTML is persisted to the database

property.name: allowedTags
property.description-key: Comma-separated list of allowed HTML tags (e.g. p,br,b,i,strong,em,a,ul,ol,li,table,thead,tbody,tr,th,td). Adding 'style' is a security risk; use only with trusted content. Empty = no tags allowed.

property.name: allowedAttributes
property.description-key: Comma-separated list of allowed attributes (e.g. href for links). Empty = no attributes allowed.
